summary_en: LIFENET INSURANCE will acquire 100% of KIZUNA MICRO INSURANCE to establish a wholly-owned subsidiary. The acquisition is conditional on regulatory approvals. The micro insurance license will enable LIFENET to rapidly develop and deliver smaller, simpler insurance products tailored to partner platforms' customer bases.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Acquisition of Shares of a Micro Insurance Company (Full Subsidiary) and the Commencement of New Business
translation_en_brief:
LIFENET INSURANCE announced on October 15, 2026 that its Board of Directors resolved to enter into a share transfer agreement to acquire 100% of KIZUNA MICRO INSURANCE COMPANY and establish it as a wholly-owned subsidiary. The transaction is conditional upon obtaining necessary regulatory approvals and licenses.

The acquisition supports LIFENET's medium-term plan priority area "Embedded," which focuses on seamlessly delivering life insurance products through partner company platforms. The company identified growing customer demand for smaller, simpler insurance products suited to diverse lifestyles within partner ecosystems. LIFENET determined that a micro insurance subsidiary would provide the operational flexibility and rapid product development capability needed to serve these needs cost-effectively alongside its comprehensive insurance offerings.

KIZUNA MICRO INSURANCE was established in July 2022 and is located in Nagoya. As of March 31, 2026, its principal shareholder was Takaaki Ota (84.37%). LIFENET will acquire the full 100% stake through the principal shareholder. The transaction details including acquisition price and closing date were not disclosed. Financial statements show the target company recorded operating losses in its recent fiscal years, with a loss of approximately 22.76 million yen in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026.
